description: Synthetic demonstration protocol for specimen tube transfer across experiment rig zones. FOR TESTING AND DEMO ONLY.

steps.title: Pick up centrifuge tube
steps.instruction: Carefully pick up the centrifuge tube from the specimen stand.
steps.voice_message: Please pick up the centrifuge tube.

steps.title: Transfer tube towards target rack
steps.instruction: Move the centrifuge tube towards the target tube rack.
steps.voice_message: Move the centrifuge tube towards the target tube rack.

steps.title: Place tube in tube rack
steps.instruction: Carefully place the centrifuge tube into the target tube rack.
steps.voice_message: Place the centrifuge tube securely into the tube rack.

steps.title: Release specimen tube
steps.instruction: Release your grip on the tube and verify stable placement.
steps.voice_message: Release the tube and ensure it is stably seated.
